_comment: Second question set: paraphrases, near-miss conditions and known-absent topics, to measure robustness beyond the 11 sample questions. Same scoring as the sample set. Expectations are written from the corpus text only.

questions.question: Adult with sore throat and fever, Centor 3 — which antibiotic and for how long?
must_include: Amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily for 5 days

questions.question: Penicillin-allergic adult with streptococcal pharyngitis: what does the workflow say to use?
must_include: Azithromycin 500 mg once daily for 3 days

questions.question: Should antibiotics be given for a clearly viral sore throat?
must_include: Do not use antibiotics for clearly viral sore throat
